usage: Single source of truth for cross-session progress. Set `current` to the id being worked on (null when idle), keep `updated` in YYYY-MM-DD, and move finished items to status `done` instead of deleting them. Milestone ids track docs/PRD.md section 14.

statusLegend.in_progress: Actively being worked on in the current session.
statusLegend.blocked: Waiting on a dependency or decision.
statusLegend.deferred: Intentionally postponed; not needed for the current release.
statusLegend.dropped: No longer planned; kept for history.

priorityLegend.P1: Should ship before the next release.
priorityLegend.P2: Nice to have; safe to defer.

tasks.title: Encrypted database at rest
tasks.notes: Decided 2026-10-11: not needed now. The OS already encrypts at rest for most users, and the cost is high -- vendored OpenSSL on 3 OSes (perl + nasm), an exemption in scripts/check-offline.mjs (which forbids openssl/openssl-sys), and an unrecoverable DB if the passphrase is forgotten. Revisit only if backups move to the cloud or the machine is shared/resold.

tasks.title: UI & PDF localization
tasks.notes: Bahasa Indonesia, in progress. Done: the i18n core (src/lib/i18n.svelte.ts plus locales/en.ts and id.ts, type-checked for key parity), the shell and nav, the shared components (command palette, line items shell, charts, toast, celebration), the reminder email, and Settings > Appearance with a language switch (setting key ui.locale). Locale-aware money/dates follow the UI language. Remaining: the content routes (dashboard, invoices, estimates, clients, catalog, reports and the other settings pages) still render English literal strings, and the PDF document locale (pdf/labels.rs) is still English-only.

tasks.title: Tablet & narrow-window layout
tasks.notes: Below 820px the sidebar becomes a slide-in drawer behind a top bar (menu button; Escape, backdrop and nav links close it; inert when closed). Main padding tightens, page headers and toolbars wrap, and data tables scroll inside their card. Window minimum lowered to 480x480 in tauri.conf.json. Static checks and build pass; a visual pass on a tablet or narrow window is still worth doing.
